title: Union-find: ranks grow, paths get compressed
notes: Two sets grow around E and D, each of rank 1. C-G joins them: a tie, so D goes under E and E's rank grows to 2. Then FIND-SET(C) walks C → D → E, and path compression points C straight at E. The last edge, C-H, adds nothing.
ops: A-E, A-G, A-H, B-H, C-D, C-F, C-G, C-H
